name: Bath-sheba
description: David's wife living at the time of United Monarchy

points: And David sent and enquired after the woman. And one said, Is not this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?

And one said, Is not this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite? Somebody with a spiritual mind made it clear: this is somebody's wife. And David sent messengers, and took her anyway. Wisdom and understanding were right there, and he ignored them.

David comforted Bathsheba his wife, went in unto her, and she bare a son, and he called his name Solomon; and the Most High loved him, and sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet, who called his name Jedidiah, because of the Most High.

note.label: 2 Samuel 12: Nathan's Parable and the Judgment on David's House

points: To the chief musician, a Psalm of David, written after Nathan the prophet came to him following his sin with Bathsheba, the wife of Uriah one of the soldiers in David's army.

note.label: Psalm 51: Acknowledge, Repent, and Be Cleansed
